anomalies.observed: On the schematic, the MAX3485 DE/RE enable net is labelled NET0001, and the same NET0001 label also appears on M5Stack bus pin 13 of J1 and J8. Q3's collector and the 20 k pull-down R4 are connected to this same NET0001 node.
anomalies.expected: The DE/RE enable line should be a separate control net driven by the auto-direction transistor from /TXD2, not merged with an M5Stack bus GPIO/UART pin. The specification describes Q2 as toggling DE/RE from /TXD2 and lists the bus pass-through signals without assigning pin 13 to the transceiver enable.

evidence.quote: J1 pin 13 NET0001; J8 pin 13 NET0001; U2 pins 2/3 tied to NET0001; Q3 collector to NET0001; R4 20k from NET0001 to GND (sheet 1/1)
Q2 BC857 (PNP) Auto TX/RX direction-control transistor: driven from /TXD2 (via R1 10k, R2 5.1k) to toggle the MAX3485 DE/RE enable pins.

anomalies.impact: The M5Stack bus pin 13 (G1/TXD0 per the pinout table) is shorted to the RS-485 transceiver direction-control net. This loads or fights the bus pin, can corrupt UART0/GPIO13 use, and may prevent reliable serial-servo direction control or damage the port.

parsed.summary: The schematic otherwise appears to implement the specified PWM/serial jumper-selectable design, but the NET0001 label bridges the MAX3485 DE/RE enable net to M5Stack bus pin 13, which is not intended and would change board behavior.
